question_text: The function proper_sum(n) returns the sum of proper divisors of positive integer n. Construct classify_grid(grid) in Python. Return three lists(low, equal, high) containing each grid value whose proper-divisor sum is respectively less than, equal to, or greater than that value. Preserve row-major order and all repeated values. Do not modify grid; call proper_sum for each value.
adaptation_rationale: Preserves nested traversal, function decomposition and three-way classification; Python dynamic outputs remove legacy fixed-array index bookkeeping while retaining 10 substantive marking points.

marking_points.criterion: Initializes three distinct empty output lists.
Traverses every value in the row.
Uses comparison with the original value, not an index.
Preserves row-major order and duplicates, with each value assigned exactly once.
Returns the three lists in the required order after traversal.
